Hail, Mighty Hero, 

Word has reached me that Rytlock and Logan have been spotted together, and not threatening each other. Whatever you did at the Citadel of Flame, it seems to have taken.

 Zojja has been in pursuit of her master's other apprentice, Kudu, since she drove him out of Sorrow's Embrace. Kudu has set up a great laboratory in the heart of the expansive Inquest base at the Crucible of Eternity, in the eastern part of the Steamspur Mountains. 

Kudu has been continuing his experiments in draconic energy, and I have no doubt that Zojja intends to confront him, alone if she has to. I have sent word to Rytlock and Logan, but don't know if they will arrive in time. Can you help?

As always,

Your Herald

...the most special evening I have ever experienced—to gaze into your eyes, the twilight reflected, an eternity contained. There can be no other for me. I have lived and died every moment waiting for the gift of your everlasting companionship. That you would entertain my overtures though I have no titles, lands, nor family name to lay at your feet—I am overcome. [lbracket]Ed. Note: Scale back on the allusions to my generosity.[rbracket] I have not the words to express the fullness in my heart.

Oh, great Joko, my existence is but to long for you... Every breath I take is but to beg for your attentions. I know that I cannot mean the world to you as you mean it to me. Yet, if I might even inhabit one flickering thought of your great mind, my very life would have achieved its pinnacle. [lbracket]Ed. Note: You use "great" as a qualifier twice. Is that the extent of your vocabulary?[rbracket]

Without the blessing of your presence, the sun, the sands, the warm caress of the breeze hold no appeal. I forget to eat while thinking of you; I cannot sleep—dreams of you are more fleeting than waking contemplations of your mellifluent voice, your soaring intellect, your ascendant countenance...

[lbracket]Editor's Note: I was assured that you were the premiere bard, the preeminent troubadour in all of Elona, worthy of this commission. Have a care. Those who disappoint Joko tend to burn in the flames of their failures.[rbracket]

Citizens of Kaineng,

Due largely in part to increasing fears related to violence between the local Am Fah and Jade Brotherhood gangs, the Celestial Ministry is in debate over issuing a temporary nighttime curfew in the following city sectors: Vizunah Square, Wajjun Bazaar, and Bukdek Byway.

This is a direct reaction to the incident at Wajjun Bazaar last week, where eight individuals were killed near the marketplace. Of the dead, it was determined that six of the individuals were affiliated with the gangs, while two were unarmed civilians simply caught in the fray. Although the exact cause of this incident is still unknown, such violence will not be tolerated.

While investigations continue, please be mindful during daily activities and avoid unnecessary travel.

Flames, guide us.

Signed, Minister Zal
